events.title: Skunk Creek, Grays Harbor County, WA
events.thought: End of day twenty-one. Deep in the Olympic Peninsula.

events.title: Mount Rainier National Park Entrance
events.thought: Through the gates of Rainier — the mountain gods are watching.
events.photoCaption: Timber arch entrance gate to Mount Rainier National Park, firs dripping green behind.

events.title: Alpine Valley, Mount Rainier NP
events.thought: That valley view from Rainier's flanks is the kind of thing that resets everything.
events.photoCaption: Deep alpine valley on the flanks of Mount Rainier, winding road visible far below.
